'''Nopsin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Journal11" /> located in the [[Nopsin system/Legends|Nopsin system]], a part of the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC Nopsin" /> At one point by approximately [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="TORDate">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act II of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which includes [[Pierce]] joining the entourage of the future [[Empire's Wrath]] per {{TORcite|type=class|[[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]]|General Faraire|[[Taris/Legends|Taris]]}}, takes place between [[3642 BBY]] and [[3641 BBY]]. Since {{TORcite|type=class|[[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]]|Reallocation|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}} establishes the [[Cleansing of Nopsin]] took place before that event, it must have occurred at some point by approximately 3642 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]].</ref> the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] carried out the operation known as the [[Cleansing of Nopsin]] there.<ref name="Reallocation">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]]|Reallocation|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

Nopsin at some point became the third and final planet [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tren]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Journal11" /> from<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Tren]]|system=[[Opitha Tren system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Opitha Tren system/Legends|Opitha Tren system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> After the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Journal11" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Nopsin overwhelmingly voted in favor of joining that state, which led the remaining [[Tren resistance]] movements to give up any hope of persuading the Tren to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. At the time, the young Tren idealist [[Opit-Wenbruh]]&mdash;who was fifty-eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the Alliance&mdash;was serving in Nopsin's military, going on to serve with the Rebellion after his service with the former ended.<ref name="Journal11" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|General, I served under you at the Cleansing of Nopsin.|A possible line of dialogue by Pierce to Greist in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic''|<ref name="Reallocation" />}}
Nopsin was first mentioned in an installment of the [[Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)|''Cracken's Rebel Operatives'']] series of articles that was published in the [[November]] [[1996]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine. The article was written by [[Craig Robert Carey|C. Robert Carey]] and [[Trevor J. Wilson]].<ref name="Journal11" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Nopsin [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Nopsin itself, in grid square I-15.<ref name="TEA" /> In an optional conversation in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]] player character's companion character [[Pierce]] can mention the Cleansing of Nopsin to their former superior [[Imperial officer (reconstituted Sith Empire)|officer]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Greist]].<ref name="Reallocation" />
